brief: private static MimeType getRegisteredMimeType(MimeTypes mimeTypes, String name){}
method_comment: * Not {@link MimeTypes#forName(String)}: that registers a new, glob-less type for * any name it doesn't recognize, so text/plain; charset=UTF-8 would * lose its extension and add a registry entry per charset seen. This prefers an * exact parameterized match (application/dita+xml;format=map is real) * and otherwise falls back to the base type. * * @return the registered type, or null if unknown or invalid
